Setiap input muncul sebagai label katakana di bawah controller, misalnya アールティー untuk RT, dan riak cahaya cyan menyebar saat stik ditekan. Trigger LT dan RT terisi sesuai tekanan. Warna aksen bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Cyber Tokyo Night Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. A semi-transparent body over a Tokyo night skyline with pink and cyan neon edges. Every input shows up as a katakana label below the controller, for example アールティー for RT, and a cyan ripple of light spreads when you press a stick. LT and RT fill with how far you press. The accent color is adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Sakura Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. A pink body with cherry blossom branches and falling petals, sticks and a D-pad with a flower at the center, and a cherry tree on the Home display. LT and RT fill with how far you press, and the sticks shift as you move them. The accent color is adjustable.
